Rina Gupta: Heads-up 3 Alex Monroe (SWE Staff) confirmed hybrid onsite for Wed Jun 11. Flying in, arriving 09:10. Has severe peanut allergy and requests a quiet space between interviews.
Alejandra Rivera: Thanks Rina. Do we have flight + pickup details?
Rina Gupta: Flight lands 09:10 at SFO, shuttle to office booked for 09:40. Asking for quiet room from 10:00-13:30.
Matt O'Neill: I can move my slot to 11:00 to give buffer.
Priya Shah: I'll be remote for the loop, can take notes and leave async feedback.
Alejandra Rivera: Need at least two in-person interviewers. Ben, can you be onsite? @Ben Cho
Ben Cho: Yep I can be onsite at 11:00.
Alejandra Rivera: Facilities - please reserve a small quiet room (no pods), whiteboard, phone, and a Mac loaner with charger. Also badge access for guest.
Facilities: Reserving Quiet Room A (3rd floor). Mac loaner + charger will be at Concierge. Badge printed and on desk by 09:00. AV/test scheduled 09:30.
Rina Gupta: Catering note3 candidate has "severe peanut allergy" 3 please ensure peanut-free and label items. Candidate prefers vegan but it's optional.
Facilities: Catering order placed: peanut-free menu + vegan option. We'll mark allergen on tray and provide separate utensils.
Alejandra Rivera: Schedule pasted below (will update calendar invite):
```
10:00-10:20 - Candidate arrival / check-in (Quiet Room A)
10:30-11:00 - System design quick screen (Ben)
11:00-12:00 - Technical panel (Matt + Ben)
12:00-12:30 - Quiet prep / break
12:30-13:00 - Lunch (peanut-free)
13:00-13:30 - Hiring manager chat (remote)
```
Matt O'Neill: I'll be onsite for the panel. Priya remote.
Priya Shah: I'll add my feedback doc to the calendar and share a recording link.
Rina Gupta: Also need travel stipend pre-auth and taxi expense covered.
PeopleOps Bot: Pre-auth created: HR-TRVL-2026-058. Please attach receipts to the expense ticket after visit.
Alejandra Rivera: Ben, please be point for guest greeter at Concierge and confirm Mac loaner pick up.
Ben Cho: Will meet candidate at Concierge at 09:45, sticky note on laptop with name.
Facilities: Confirmed pickup location: Concierge desk, Mac loaner tagged. AV will be on at 10:00.
Rina Gupta: I'll send confirmation email to candidate with arrival instructions, badge pickup, and dietary note.
Matt O'Neill: Thanks everyone. If timing shifts ping here. :thumbsup: 
Alejandra Rivera: I'll update the invite with the quiet-room host checklist and post an emergency contact.
PeopleOps Bot: Calendar invite updated and sent to attendees.
